answer: The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Nobody is waved through free: 95 stamped dockets, each costing £26 to have checked is the price, and the jade never covers it twice. The desk only stamps a name that carries Tinbound hammerman kibble licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence hammermen renew after smelting house trials. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The tundra is on the docket. One ember, one entry.
